bio_en: Abgar Tarkhanian was born in 1887 in Hartkon, a village bordering the Mush plain, at the height of the Hamidian massacres. As a young man he gathered a few patriotic youths around him for self-defence, drawing the attention of the government and the Kurdish beys. When a feared Kurd was sent to kill him at harvest time, Abgar overpowered him. He remained a faithful ARF fighter all his life and died in 1964; his eulogy, signed Vanbek, appeared in Alik.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Quote #15 is attributed to him. Possibly related to Deli Ghazo (Ghazar Tarkhanian, #256) - not stated.
